def my_power_function(base, exp, mod):
    """Customizable exponential function for computing g^(A*b) mod p."""
    if exp < 0:
        x = 1 / base
        y = -exp
    elif exp == 0:
        x = 1
    else:
        n = my_power_function(base, exp // 2, mod)
        x = n * n
        if exp % 2 == 1:
            x *= base
    return x % mod

def compute_shared_secret(p, g, private_key):
    """Compute the shared secret using DH key exchange."""
    public_key = my_power_function(g, private_key, p)
    shared_secret = my_power_function(public_key, private_key, p)
    return shared_secret
